name: Witchy Werewolf Wives
source:
What would you do when your would-be wife is a werewolf? Cinch and her girlfriend, Chang'e, go through changes of their own as they find out more about themselves.

[From [url=https://shapeshiftgl.itch.io/www]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你的未来妻子是狼人，你会怎么做？随着对自己的了解越来越多，辛奇和她的女朋友嫦娥也经历了自己的变化。

[来自[url=https://shapeshiftgl.itch.io/www]Itch.io[/url]]
